name: tail ring v1
note: tail ring v1 (2026-10-14), for tailring_v1_post.py, appended after P-tailbase3. The lowest tail's root ring (the region ellipsoid, faded) is remeshed from the skin's own level set (step .0025, blur sigma .0015 inside, so the surface does not change: new surface within .0001 of the old) and stitched to the old skin; seam relax 60 iterations over 6 rings, fold repair 10 passes. Removes the ripple bands that tail v7's old collar vertices left after tail base v2/v3 moved them onto the new surface. World units, +y back.
